/* selectKeyValue - Lee MS */
SELECT ISRY_APP.SA_FN_GET_RENU_NO('CM', #{USER_ID}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) FROM DUAL

/* selectReqById - Lee MS */
SELECT A.CMIT_SE_CD AS CMIT_SE_CD, A.ESNTL_LINK_MNG_NO AS ESNTL_LINK_MNG_NO, A.ESNTL_LINK_INST_SE_CD AS ESNTL_LINK_INST_SE_CD, B.OGDP_INST_DTL_SE_CD AS OGDP_INST_DTL_SE_CD, A.INST_NM AS INST_NM, A.JBTTL_NM AS JBTTL_NM, C##RG.DEC_B64(A.ENTRST_PIC_NM_ENCPT) AS ENTRST_PIC_NM, A.CMIT_JBTTL_SE_CD AS CMIT_JBTTL_SE_CD, A.ENTRST_BGNG_YMD AS ENTRST_BGNG_YMD, A.ENTRST_END_YMD AS ENTRST_END_YMD, A.NOW_ACTVT_YN AS NOW_ACTVT_YN, C##RG.DEC_B64(A.PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS PIC_MBL_TELNO, A.OFFM_TELNO AS OFFM_TELNO, A.LCGOV_PBSVNT_YN AS LCGOV_PBSVNT_YN, A.PIC_NO AS PIC_NO, A.INST_NO AS INST_NO, A.CMIT_CNSTTN_MNG_NO AS CMIT_CNSTTN_MNG_NO FROM ACA610 A, ACA600 B WHERE A.ESNTL_LINK_MNG_NO = B.ESNTL_LINK_MNG_NO(+) AND A.CMIT_CNSTTN_MNG_NO = #{CMIT_CNSTTN_MNG_NO}

/* saveData - Lee MS */
MERGE INTO ACA610 /* 위원회구성정보 */ USING DUAL ON (CMIT_CNSTTN_MNG_NO = #{CMIT_CNSTTN_MNG_NO}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CMIT_SE_CD = #{CMIT_SE_CD}, /* 위원회구분코드 */ ESNTL_LINK_MNG_NO = #{ESNTL_LINK_MNG_NO}, /* 필수연계관리번호 */ ESNTL_LINK_INST_SE_CD = #{ESNTL_LINK_INST_SE_CD}, /* 필수연계기관구분코드 */ INST_NM = #{INST_NM}, /* 기관명 */ JBTTL_NM = #{JBTTL_NM}, /* 직책명 */ CMIT_JBTTL_SE_CD = #{CMIT_JBTTL_SE_CD}, /* 위원회직책구분코드 */ ENTRST_PIC_NM_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{ENTRST_PIC_NM}), /* 위촉담당자명 */ ENTRST_BGNG_YMD = #{ENTRST_BGNG_YMD}, /* 위촉시작일자 */ ENTRST_END_YMD = #{ENTRST_END_YMD}, /* 위촉종료일자 */ NOW_ACTVT_YN = #{NOW_ACTVT_YN}, /* 현재활동여부 */ PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = C##RG.ENC_B64(#{PIC_MBL_TELNO}), /* 담당자휴대전화 */ OFFM_TELNO = #{OFFM_TELNO}, /* 사무실전화번호 */ LCGOV_PBSVNT_YN = #{LCGOV_PBSVNT_YN}, /* 지자체공무원여부 */ PIC_NO = #{PIC_NO}, /* 담당자번호 */ INST_NO = #{INST_NO}, /* 기관번호 */ LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID}, /* 최종수정자아이디 */ LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일시 */ WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( CMIT_CNSTTN_MNG_NO, /* 위원회구성관리번호 */ CMIT_SE_CD, /* 위원회구분코드 */ ESNTL_LINK_MNG_NO, /* 필수연계관리번호 */ ESNTL_LINK_INST_SE_CD, /* 필수연계기관구분코드 */ INST_NM, /* 기관명 */ JBTTL_NM, /* 직책명 */ CMIT_JBTTL_SE_CD, /* 위원회직책구분코드 */ ENTRST_PIC_NM_ENCPT, /* 위촉담당자명 */ ENTRST_BGNG_YMD, /* 위촉시작일자 */ ENTRST_END_YMD, /* 위촉종료일자 */ NOW_ACTVT_YN, /* 현재활동여부 */ PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, /* 담당자휴대전화 */ OFFM_TELNO, /* 사무실전화번호 */ LCGOV_PBSVNT_YN, /* 지자체공무원여부 */ PIC_NO, /* 담당자번호 */ INST_NO, /* 기관번호 */ FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{CMIT_CNSTTN_MNG_NO}, #{CMIT_SE_CD}, #{ESNTL_LINK_MNG_NO}, #{ESNTL_LINK_INST_SE_CD}, #{INST_NM}, #{JBTTL_NM}, #{CMIT_JBTTL_SE_CD}, C##RG.ENC_B64(#{ENTRST_PIC_NM}), #{ENTRST_BGNG_YMD}, #{ENTRST_END_YMD}, #{NOW_ACTVT_YN}, C##RG.ENC_B64(#{PIC_MBL_TELNO}), #{OFFM_TELNO}, #{LCGOV_PBSVNT_YN}, #{PIC_NO}, #{INST_NO}, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )
